body: Create a playful 4:5 birthday collectible card with a large portrait, cobalt blue and silver foil textures. Preserve the reference person's facial identity and hairstyle. Show a waist-up portrait wearing a paper party crown, framed by small stars and restrained confetti. Use an original card layout with strong readable typography. Render these exact texts: "LEVEL {{age}} UNLOCKED", "{{personName}}", and "Cake first. Responsibilities later." Keep all three text elements inside generous margins. No tiny statistics, brand logos or additional text.

help.en: Use a short age such as 30.

instructions.en: Upload one clear adult portrait. The demonstration reference is AI-generated. Keep all lettering in English.

en.title: Birthday Main Character
en.description: Turn a portrait into a birthday collectible card with an editable name and milestone.
en.body:
## How to use

Upload one clear adult portrait. The demonstration reference is AI-generated. Keep all lettering in English.

## What to check

Change the name and age before copying the prompt. Check the face, all three text elements and the card margins.
